      Travel to United States

      Discover the Iconic Wonders of the United States with Saudia Airlines

      Experience the vast energy and boundless creativity of the United States. From the neon glow of world famous cities to the quiet majesty of its natural landscapes, America offers a kaleidoscope of adventures. Fly with Saudia to enjoy a seamless journey characterized by warm hospitality and modern comfort as you set out to explore the heart of the American dream.


      1. Savor Diverse Regional Flavors

      Taste your way through a melting pot of culinary traditions. From slow smoked Texas barbecue to fresh Atlantic seafood and spicy Southwestern soul, every plate tells a story of local heritage and seasonal bounty.


      2. Explore Iconic National Parks

      Witness the breathtaking scale of nature at its finest. Marvel at the dramatic peaks of the Rocky Mountains, the deep hues of the Grand Canyon, or the misty forests of the Pacific Northwest.


      3. Attend A Major Sporting Event

      Feel the electric pulse of an American stadium. Whether it is the crack of a baseball bat or the roar of a football crowd, participating in these spirited traditions is a quintessential local experience.


      4. Discover World-Class Art Museums

      Ignite your imagination in renowned galleries from New York to Chicago. Wander through halls filled with everything from ancient treasures to cutting edge contemporary masterpieces that define global culture.


      5. Experience Thrilling Theme Parks

      Unlock your inner child at the world’s most famous entertainment destinations. Enjoy high speed coasters and magical storytelling that bring your favorite cinematic moments to life with high energy fun.


      6. Enjoy Live Jazz And Blues

      Immerse yourself in the rhythmic soul of the South. From the intimate clubs of New Orleans to the legendary stages of Chicago, let the smooth melodies and powerful vocals transport you.


      7. Celebrate Vibrant Cultural Festivals

      Join the party at lively celebrations that honor the nation’s rich diversity. Experience the color and joy of community parades, music festivals, and traditional holiday gatherings throughout the year.


      8. Join Immersive Cooking Classes

      Bring the taste of America home with you. Master the art of southern comfort food or classic coastal dishes by learning from expert chefs who share the secrets of local ingredients.


      9. Tour Historic Landmark Sites

      Walk through the pages of history at iconic monuments. From the cobblestone streets of New England to the grand memorials in Washington D.C., discover the milestones that shaped a nation.


      10. Embark On A Scenic Road Trip

      Hit the open road for the ultimate journey of discovery. Drive along the legendary Route 66 or the stunning Pacific Coast Highway to see the changing face of the American landscape at your own pace.

      Scroll to view more →

      Cities You Should Visit When Traveling to United States

      1. New York

      Feel the electric pulse of the world’s most famous skyline. From the bright lights of Broadway to the tranquil paths of Central Park, this city offers an endless array of world-class museums, iconic landmarks, and a culinary scene that spans the globe.


      2. Washington

      Walk through the heart of American history in a city defined by its monumental beauty. Explore the inspiring Smithsonian museums for free, stand before the Lincoln Memorial, and discover vibrant neighborhoods filled with local flavor and international charm.


      3. Los Angeles

      Chase the sun in the capital of creativity and coastal cool. Hike up to the legendary Hollywood Sign for a panoramic view, relax on the shores of Santa Monica, and immerse yourself in the cinematic magic of a city where every corner feels like a movie set.
